title: INT8 weight-only profile integration: hybrid sequence-aware regression harness
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Integrate INT8 weight-only (GPTQ/AWQ) quantization profiles into the canonical CI/regression harness with sequence-length aware tests and calibration workflows. Establish accuracy validation gates against FP32 baselines across short/medium/long sequence distributions, add fallback FP8 verification steps, and wire telemetry for drift detection.
steps: Create a new integration runner that exercises INT8 weight-only model variants across a matrix of sequence lengths (8, 64, 512, 2048) and batch sizes
Add calibration step that runs post-quantization per-model calibration using the canonical calibration dataset and store calibration artifacts in the profile registry
Implement accuracy comparator that computes token-level logprob deltas, top-k exact-match, and embedding cosine drift vs FP32 baseline
Add canary pipeline that runs lightweight subset on each PR and nightly full-sweep with golden-seed for determinism
Hook regression failures to an automated rollback playbook and alert on-call with targeted debug snapshot
acceptance_criteria: CI runs produce pass/fail status for every quant-profile variant against predefined thresholds
Calibration artifacts persist and are retrievable by model-serving during canary rollout
Median token logprob delta <= 0.02 for short/medium sequences and <= 0.05 for long sequences across benchmark set
No more than 1% of prompts exceed semantic-similarity drift threshold (cosine < 0.88) vs FP32 baseline
Playbook validated: a failing canary triggers automatic fallback to non-quantized or alternate profile and creates a postmortem ticket
comments: 2025-01-12 — Kickoff: scoped matrix and identified canonical datasets; assigned work to Marco for runner and to Sofia for telemetry hooks
2025-01-22 — Early branch: runner prototype handles variable seq lengths and reports token-level stats; observed higher drift on conversational contexts at 2048 tokens
2025-01-28 — Calibration tweak: added per-head scale clipping during AWQ calibration which reduced drift on long contexts by ~12% in synthetic eval
2025-02-03 — PR review feedback from Research: request to include perplexity and semantic similarity metrics; added embedding-based comparator
2025-02-10 — Nightly job flakiness: discovered nondeterminism due to RNG seeding across CUDA kernels; deterministic seed enforced and golden-seed tests added
2025-02-14 — Integration test: FP8 fallback path added; still seeing occasional >0.05 logprob delta on one legacy model family; triage assigned to ENG-98765
